data.name: Bad Dogs
data.detailed_description:
R A C E .  R E V E N G E .   R E V O L U T I O N .

BAD DOGS is a high-octane, choice-driven cyberpunk arcade mosaic that blends 80s vector-grid mechanics with a modern neon-noir comic aesthetic. The city is a digital cage ruled by the all-seeing Syndicate. Behind the wheel of a high-speed cyber-vehicle, tear through 10 heavily guarded city sectors to reclaim the streets... or sell them out.

Whether you're hunting phantom signals, chasing global leaderboard glory, or just zoning out on a glowing wireframe highway, the grid is yours.

THREE MAIN MODES

  • STORY MODE (Cyber Highway & City Hack): Navigate an immersive, branching narrative centered around The Pink Car—a phantom vehicle encrypted obituaries claim was vaporized two years ago. Choose your faction, tackle high-stakes checkpoints, hack through tactical roadblock minigames, and decide the fate of the city at the Syndicate Core: Believe in the revolution, or Deny your network for corporate immunity.

  • RACING MODE (OutRun-Style Chase): Pure, subterranean time-attack adrenaline. Rocket through abandoned subway grids, master high/low manual gear shifting, draft tight traffic lines to charge high-risk turbo boosts, and outrun the Syndicate’s relentless agent: The Enforcer.

  • ARCADE MODE (Endless Hub): Step into a limitless, escalating hub of rule-breaking minigames. Smash through firewalls in tactical Brick-Breaker events, weave through heavy artillery in Sewer Shooters, dodge diving drones in Galaga-style scrambles, and clear spatial grid locks.

CHILL VECTOR CRUISING

Not every run needs to be a pulse-pounding chase. Need to decompress? BAD DOGS doubles as a chill cyberpunk sanctuary. Drop the pressure, dial into the retro-futuristic atmosphere, and spend a few minutes just cruising down our matrix/vector highways—enjoying the aesthetic flow, vector geometry, and the rhythm of the open road.

LOCAL & INTERNATIONAL LEADERBOARDS

Test your skill on your own terms across all three game modes:

  • Local Leaderboards: Track your personal bests and race against your own ghosts on your local machine.

  • Global Leaderboards: Sync directly with Steam servers to put your high scores and sector lap times on the line against drivers worldwide.

GAME FEATURES

  • Neo-Noir Comic Visuals: A crisp fusion of classic early-era 3D vector graphics and high-contrast comic-book character design.

  • Branching Sci-Fi Narrative: Every checkpoint presents high-stakes infiltration choices, radically shifting your route, allies, and briefings.

  • Four Faction Destinies: Align with the Red Crow (Rebellion), Yellow Sparrow (Ecology), Blue Seagull (Exodus), or Green Mantis (Oblivion).

  • Dynamic Retro Roadblocks: Action smoothly seamlessly blends high-speed vector driving with modern reinterpretations of classic arcade mechanics (Arkanoid, Galaga, Tempest).

  • Mighty Chip-Prog Soundtrack: Powered by an original score composed by Jørn Lavoll (Teslagrad 2), combining authentic hardware sounds from the Atari ST (YM2149) and Commodore 64 (SID) with heavy, modern orchestral production.

data.short_description: Tear through a neon-drenched cyberpunk metropolis in a high-speed choice-driven arcade mosaic. Uncover the mystery of the phantom Pink Car, master mini-game roadblocks, and decide whether to fulfill a revolutionary mission or betray your underground allies to the Syndicate.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD Phenom II X4 965 (Dual-Core 2.0 GHz or faster)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 / AMD Radeon RX 550 (Must support DirectX 12 / Vulkan 1.2)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Integrated Audio
  • Additional Notes: Requires a graphics card with full support for Vulkan 1.2 or DirectX

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur) or late
  • Processor: Dual-Core Intel Core i5 (2.0 GHz or faster) or Apple M1 (Universal Binary supported)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics 640 or Apple M1 GPU (Metal compatible)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Integrated Audio
  • Additional Notes: macOS 11.0+ is required due to Metal/MoltenVK rendering requirements in Godot 4.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, SteamOS 3.0 (Steam Deck), or equivalent modern 64-bit Linux distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD Phenom II X4 965 (Dual-Core 2.0 GHz or faster)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 / AMD Radeon RX 550 (Must support Vulkan 1.2 / Mesa 20.0+)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard ALSA / PulseAudio / PipeWire compatible
  • Additional Notes: Graphics driver must have support for Vulka
